source.name: Last Asylum: Plague Wiki
source.note: Wiki game version 1.0.87. Building pages provide only reference levels for most upgradeable buildings. Displayed costs and times may be rounded; durationMinutesApprox is approximate.

semantics.note: unlocksAt is the Sanctuary level for placing the first copy. baseMaxCopies excludes research-unlocked extra copies. effectsAtLevel and powerAtLevel describe the level reached. upgradeCost and durationMinutesApprox describe reaching that level; null means unavailable or not precise. Non-Sanctuary upgradeable buildings have reference levels only; do not interpolate or sum their sample costs.
